subject: Renewal + Procurement concierge: PO pre-approval and vendor refresh
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@heliomeds.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal + Procurement concierge: PO pre-approval and vendor refresh

Hi Sarah —

Hope you're well. We're kicking off the renewal for Helio Medical Systems (term starts 2028-01-01). Based on usage trends you flagged, the recommended capacity uplift and new term are below:

- Term: 12 months (2028-01-01 to 2028-12-31)
- Capacity: +30% committed tokens (to cover Q1 burst)
- Price: standard renewal pricing (we'll include a one-time onboarding credit)

To minimize procurement friction, our Ops team can supply a PO pre-approval packet and an updated vendor-refresh bundle (SOC2 attestation, certs, contact points). If helpful we can pre-fill the PO template and route the SOW for DocuSign so procurement can issue a PO faster.

Attached: Helio_Renewal_SOW_v3.pdf (draft), PO_PreApproval_Form.xlsx (blank).

Would you prefer: (A) we send a pre-approved PO packet to procurement now, or (B) wait for your internal signoff and then send the full packet? If A, please confirm the billing contact and approximate PO lead time.

Thanks — I can jump on a quick call if you want to walk procurement through the pre-approval packet.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0189

Attachments: Helio_Renewal_SOW_v3.pdf (PDF, 243 KB); PO_PreApproval_Form.xlsx (Excel, 12 KB)

From: Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@heliomeds.com>

Cc: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@heliomeds.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 10:05:37 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal + Procurement concierge: PO pre-approval and vendor refresh

Hi Sean —

Thanks for the summary. Procurement here requires: completed vendor questionnaire, SOC2 evidence, and a pre-filled PO template. We also have a vendor-refresh step where third-party risk runs a quick re-check.

Can you: 1) send the vendor questionnaire and evidence bundle, 2) pre-fill the PO_PreApproval_Form.xlsx with billing details, and 3) provide a DocuSign link for the SOW so we can expedite internal approvals?

Cc'ing Tom (VP IT) who owns vendor onboarding. Target timeline: we'd like the PO issued by the end of next week if possible.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Lewis
Procurement Manager, Helio Medical Systems
sarah.lewis@heliomeds.com

Attachment: (none)

Laura / Grace —

Quick internal plan based on Sarah's ask:

- Send completed vendor questionnaire + procurement-evidence-bundle.zip to procurement@heliomeds.com (includes SOC2, penetration test summary, encryption KMS notes).
- Pre-fill PO_PreApproval_Form.xlsx with Helio billing: Bill to "Helio Medical Systems, Attn: Accounts Payable", billing contact: ap@heliomeds.com, net-45 terms (per their org).
- Prepare DocuSign envelope for Helio_Renewal_SOW_v3.pdf and set reminder cadence (48h).
- CC Marissa for billing contact confirmation and to ensure invoices route to the right GL code.

I'll attach the pre-filled form and evidence bundle now — please check and add any missing compliance blurb. If Legal needs a rapid redline, flag it asap; we may accept a standard procurement addendum instead of full legal review to keep timing.

Sean

Attachments to send externally: Helio_Renewal_SOW_v3.pdf (DocuSign-ready), PO_PreApproval_Form_filled.xlsx, procurement-evidence-bundle.zip

- Marissa: can you confirm the GL code for Helio so I can include it on invoices?

If all good, I'll send the packet to procurement@heliomeds.com with the DocuSign link and ask for expected PO issuance date. Draft email below for your OK before external send.

—Laura
